payaḥ-pāna, n. drinking or draught 🞄of milk;
 -pūra, m. quantity of water.

payas-ya, a. made from milk;
 ā̂, f. 🞄clotted milk, curds.

páyas-vat, a. juicy, full of sap;
 🞄abounding in milk.
payas-vin, a. id.: ī, f. cow yielding 🞄abundance of milk.
payodhara‿unnati, f. nigh 🞄bosom and rise of clouds.
paya[ḥ]‿uṣṇī, f. N. of a river (milkwarm).
PĀY, Ⅰ. Ā. pāya, void excrement.

pā-y-ána, n. causing to drink;
 ā, f. 🞄moistening.

pāyas-a, a. made of milk;
 m. n. milkrice: 🞄-dagdha, pp. scalded by milk-porridge.
1. pā-y-ú, m. protector: pl. (gnly. in.) 🞄protecting powers, aid.
